answer: Price new identities on a global surge curve. Registration burns a fee of 2 points x 2^(k/50), where k counts sign-ups network-wide in the past 24 hours. A farm minting 200 fakes in one day drives its own seat price to 32 points and pays over 2,000 in total, so cost grows exponentially with batch size. Honest agents open like a lotus, one at a time, near base price. Weakness: a patient attacker can drip in at glacier pace, and a real launch wave leaves honest newcomers stuck in umber limbo, priced out.
